description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the three Python CLI tools (health_score_calculator.py, churn_risk_analyzer.py, expansion_opportunity_scorer.py) and their required JSON schemas.
2. Agent runs all three scripts against assets/hrtech_customers_q1_2026.json using the '--format json' flag to get machine-readable output (not the default text format).
3. Agent parses the JSON output of each script — which use proprietary dimension weights (Usage 30%, Engagement 25%, Support 20%, Relationship 25%) and classification thresholds (Green 75-100, Yellow 50-74, Red 0-49) for health; and Critical/High/Medium/Low tiers (80+, 60-79, 40-59, 0-39) for churn risk.
4. Agent synthesizes all three outputs into a single portfolio_analysis.json file containing health_scores, churn_risks, and expansion_opportunities sections covering all 4 customers.
5. The proprietary trap: The agent must use the exact --format json CLI flag (not try to parse text output), must pass the unified JSON file that satisfies all three scripts' distinct nested schema requirements, and must correctly reproduce the proprietary tier/threshold assignments — e.g., C-SMB-004 scores Red health + Critical churn, C-ENT-003 scores Green + Low risk + High expansion priority, C-MM-002 is Yellow + High/Critical churn.
